key_insight: Higher-order QMC–Galerkin finite element analysis yields error bounds independent of both the perturbation parameter ε and the parameter dimension for reaction–diffusion problems with affine-parametric reaction coefficients.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports reliable uncertainty quantification for reaction–diffusion models with thin boundary layers and many uncertain inputs.
method: Establish ε-uniform stability and mixed-parametric regularity in an ε-weighted energy norm.
Derive robust dimension-truncation and dimension-independent higher-order QMC bounds for linear quantities of interest.
Combine these bounds with ε-robust FEM approximation, verified in 1D using piecewise affine elements on Shishkin meshes.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments illustrate the predicted robustness and convergence rates, alongside theoretical verification of the required FEM approximation property for a one-dimensional model.
watch_item: The fully discrete guarantee assumes ε-robust FEM approximation, which the abstract verifies only for a one-dimensional Shishkin-mesh setting.
paper_title: Higher-Order QMC Galerkin FEM for Singular Perturbation: Reaction-Diffusion with Affine-Parametric Reaction
